about_the_game:
Demo features

  • 6 campaign missions from the full game

  • Unlockable guns and gadgets

  • Customizable player character with unlockable outfits and accessories

Take on missions stealthily or with a bang! The game supports various playing styles and gadget utilization to meet different playing styles. Take your enemies out from distance or meet them head on!

name: ERAZER Demo
short_description: ERAZER is real-time action shooter with pixel perfect destructible terrain. Dig, sneak or blow your way through the campaign with various weapons and gadgets including the nimble ninja rope.
